## 🐛 Fixes
- **Recurring items show the right next due date.** A yearly item first due Sep 20 was shown as next due Oct 20, one month later instead of one year. Quarterly items came due every month, and bi-weekly ones could be a week off. A first due date in the future is now respected for every frequency too. Nothing is stored differently: the dates are worked out again when shown, so existing items are correct as soon as you update.

## Download
**Android**
- **`PocketSense-v2.0.3-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v2.0.3-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v2.0.3-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Installs as an update over v2.0.x and keeps your data.

**Linux (x86_64)**: pick one.
- **Debian, Ubuntu, Mint:** `PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.deb`
  ```sh
  sudo apt install ./PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.deb
  ```
- **Fedora, openSUSE:** `PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.rpm`
  ```sh
  sudo dnf install ./PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.rpm   # or: sudo zypper install
  ```
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.AppImage`. Make it executable and run it.
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.0.3-linux-x64.tar.gz`. Unpack it and run `./PocketSense/pocket_sense`.

All need glibc 2.35 or newer and a running keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet). With the AppImage or the tarball you also need GTK 3, and `parecord` for voice entry (`pulseaudio-utils` on Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora, `libpulse` on Arch).
